mentions.name: Clarus
mentions.description: A markdown IDE and Google Docs competitor with an AI agentic editor that coaches on writing strategy in addition to proofreading. It was designed via annotated screenshots and iterative feedback to Codex, built as a side project to test how quickly a complete-feeling product could ship.
